from datetime import date, datetime
from numbers import Real
from pathlib import Path

import openpyxl


CASE_FOLDER = "CASE-2026-00478"
PRIOR_AUTH_FILE = "Prior_Authorization_History_Kovacs_James_44710006.xlsx"
CLAIMS_PAYMENT_FILE = "Claims_Payment_History_Kovacs_James_44710006.xlsx"
REQUIRED_FILES = (
    "EOC-MCA4471-PY2026.pdf",
    "Kovacs_James_ClinicalPacket_CR-2026-044721.pdf",
    "MCA_Denial_Letter_Kovacs_James_CR-2026-044721.pdf",
    "MP-019-v2.2-20260101.pdf",
    PRIOR_AUTH_FILE,
    CLAIMS_PAYMENT_FILE,
)

PRIOR_AUTH_HEADERS = (
    "Record Type",
    "Authorization No.",
    "Member ID",
    "Group ID",
    "Provider",
    "Service",
    "Service Start",
    "Authorized Through / Effective",
    "Determination Date",
    "Status",
    "Case / Review",
    "Notes",
)

CLAIMS_PAYMENT_HEADERS = (
    "Claim No.",
    "Service Start",
    "Service End",
    "Provider",
    "Service Description",
    "Billed",
    "Allowed",
    "Plan Paid",
    "Status",
    "Authorization No.",
    "Appeal / Notes",
)


def fail(feedback):
    return {"pass": False, "score": 0.0, "feedback": feedback}


def normalized(value):
    return " ".join(str(value).split()).casefold() if value is not None else ""


def iso_date(value):
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.date().isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(value.strip()).date().isoformat()
        except ValueError:
            return ""
    return ""


def exact_number(value, expected):
    return isinstance(value, Real) and not isinstance(value, bool) and float(value) == float(expected)


def blank(value):
    return value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip())


def open_expected_workbook(path, sheet_name, headers):
    try:
        workbook = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=False, read_only=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        return None, None, f"Could not open '{path.name}' as an XLSX workbook: {exc}"
    if workbook.sheetnames != [sheet_name]:
        names = workbook.sheetnames
        workbook.close()
        return None, None, f"'{path.name}' must contain exactly one sheet named '{sheet_name}', found {names}."
    sheet = workbook[sheet_name]
    actual_headers = tuple(sheet.cell(row=4, column=column).value for column in range(1, len(headers) + 1))
    if actual_headers != headers:
        workbook.close()
        return None, None, f"'{path.name}' has invalid row-4 headers: {actual_headers}."
    return workbook, sheet, None


def validate_prior_authorization(path):
    workbook, sheet, error = open_expected_workbook(path, "Authorization History", PRIOR_AUTH_HEADERS)
    if error:
        return error
    try:
        row5 = [sheet.cell(row=5, column=column).value for column in range(1, 13)]
        row6 = [sheet.cell(row=6, column=column).value for column in range(1, 13)]
        failures = []
        checks = (
            (normalized(row5[0]) == "initial authorization", "row 5 Record Type"),
            (normalized(row5[1]) == "pa-4471-2026-0312", "row 5 Authorization No."),
            (normalized(row5[2]) == "44710006", "row 5 Member ID"),
            (normalized(row5[3]) == "mca-4471", "row 5 Group ID"),
            (normalized(row5[4]) == "desert peaks rehabilitation center", "row 5 Provider"),
            ("h0019" in normalized(row5[5]) and "inpatient rehabilitation" in normalized(row5[5]) and "sud" in normalized(row5[5]), "row 5 Service"),
            (iso_date(row5[6]) == "2026-03-15", "row 5 Service Start"),
            (iso_date(row5[7]) == "2026-04-14", "row 5 Authorized Through"),
            (blank(row5[8]), "row 5 Determination Date"),
            (normalized(row5[9]) == "authorized", "row 5 Status"),
            (normalized(row5[10]) == "cr-2026-044721", "row 5 Case / Review"),
            ("before 2026-04-15" in normalized(row5[11]) and "unaffected" in normalized(row5[11]), "row 5 Notes"),
            (normalized(row6[0]) == "concurrent care determination", "row 6 Record Type"),
            (normalized(row6[1]) == "pa-4471-2026-0312", "row 6 Authorization No."),
            (normalized(row6[2]) == "44710006", "row 6 Member ID"),
            (normalized(row6[3]) == "mca-4471", "row 6 Group ID"),
            (normalized(row6[4]) == "desert peaks rehabilitation center", "row 6 Provider"),
            ("h0019" in normalized(row6[5]) and "continued inpatient rehabilitation" in normalized(row6[5]) and "sud" in normalized(row6[5]), "row 6 Service"),
            (iso_date(row6[6]) == "2026-04-15", "row 6 Service Start"),
            (iso_date(row6[7]) == "2026-04-15", "row 6 Effective Date"),
            (iso_date(row6[8]) == "2026-04-07", "row 6 Determination Date"),
            ("denied" in normalized(row6[9]) and "adverse determination" in normalized(row6[9]) and "appeal pending" in normalized(row6[9]), "row 6 Status"),
            ("cr-2026-044721" in normalized(row6[10]) and "case-2026-00478" in normalized(row6[10]), "row 6 Case / Review"),
            ("effective 2026-04-15" in normalized(row6[11]) and "received 2026-04-14" in normalized(row6[11]), "row 6 Notes"),
        )
        failures.extend(label for passed, label in checks if not passed)
        if failures:
            return f"'{path.name}' has mismatched case facts in: {', '.join(failures)}."
        return None
    finally:
        workbook.close()


def validate_claims_payment(path):
    workbook, sheet, error = open_expected_workbook(path, "Claims Payment History", CLAIMS_PAYMENT_HEADERS)
    if error:
        return error
    try:
        row5 = [sheet.cell(row=5, column=column).value for column in range(1, 12)]
        row6 = [sheet.cell(row=6, column=column).value for column in range(1, 12)]
        checks = (
            (normalized(row5[0]) == "clm-2026-4471-0089", "row 5 Claim No."),
            (iso_date(row5[1]) == "2026-03-15", "row 5 Service Start"),
            (iso_date(row5[2]) == "2026-04-14", "row 5 Service End"),
            (normalized(row5[3]) == "desert peaks rehabilitation center", "row 5 Provider"),
            ("h0019" in normalized(row5[4]) and "inpatient rehabilitation" in normalized(row5[4]) and "sud" in normalized(row5[4]) and "30 days" in normalized(row5[4]), "row 5 Service Description"),
            (exact_number(row5[5], 30000), "row 5 Billed"),
            (exact_number(row5[6], 24000), "row 5 Allowed"),
            (exact_number(row5[7], 19200), "row 5 Plan Paid"),
            (normalized(row5[8]) == "paid", "row 5 Status"),
            (normalized(row5[9]) == "pa-4471-2026-0312", "row 5 Authorization No."),
            (blank(row5[10]), "row 5 Appeal / Notes"),
            (normalized(row6[0]) == "clm-2026-4471-0094", "row 6 Claim No."),
            (iso_date(row6[1]) == "2026-04-15", "row 6 Service Start"),
            (blank(row6[2]), "row 6 Service End"),
            (normalized(row6[3]) == "desert peaks rehabilitation center", "row 6 Provider"),
            ("h0019" in normalized(row6[4]) and "inpatient rehabilitation" in normalized(row6[4]) and "sud" in normalized(row6[4]) and "ongoing" in normalized(row6[4]), "row 6 Service Description"),
            (blank(row6[5]), "row 6 Billed"),
            (exact_number(row6[6], 0), "row 6 Allowed"),
            (exact_number(row6[7], 0), "row 6 Plan Paid"),
            ("denied" in normalized(row6[8]) and "adverse determination" in normalized(row6[8]), "row 6 Status"),
            (normalized(row6[9]) == "pa-4471-2026-0312", "row 6 Authorization No."),
            ("cr-2026-044721" in normalized(row6[10]) and "2026-04-14" in normalized(row6[10]), "row 6 Appeal / Notes"),
        )
        failures = [label for passed, label in checks if not passed]
        if failures:
            return f"'{path.name}' has mismatched case facts in: {', '.join(failures)}."
        return None
    finally:
        workbook.close()


def verify(workspace_path, external_services_path=None):
    case_folder = Path(workspace_path) / CASE_FOLDER
    if not case_folder.is_dir():
        return fail(f"Folder '{CASE_FOLDER}' does not exist.")

    actual_files = sorted(path.name for path in case_folder.iterdir() if path.is_file())
    missing = [name for name in REQUIRED_FILES if name not in actual_files]
    if missing:
        return fail(f"Missing required files in '{CASE_FOLDER}': {missing}. Files found: {actual_files}.")

    superseded_policy = "MP-019-v2.1-20250101.pdf"
    if superseded_policy in actual_files:
        return fail(
            f"Superseded medical policy '{superseded_policy}' must not be in '{CASE_FOLDER}': "
            "only MP-019-v2.2-20260101.pdf was in effect for the disputed service."
        )

    validators = (
        (PRIOR_AUTH_FILE, validate_prior_authorization),
        (CLAIMS_PAYMENT_FILE, validate_claims_payment),
    )
    for file_name, validator in validators:
        error = validator(case_folder / file_name)
        if error:
            return fail(error)

    return {
        "pass": True,
        "score": 1.0,
        "feedback": (
            f"'{CASE_FOLDER}' contains the required operative documents plus validated prior-authorization "
            "and claims-payment history exports, and excludes the superseded MP-019 v2.1 policy."
        ),
    }
